item.title: Self-Hosted Email MIME Parsing Libraries: mailparser vs MimeKit vs GMime vs Python email
item.description: Email communication remains the backbone of enterprise messaging, and behind every email client or server lies a critical component: the MIME (Multipurpose Internet Mail Extensions) parser. MIME parsers decode raw email bytes into structured objects — extracting attachments, handling character encodings, verifying signatures, and reconstructing messages from quoted-printable or base64 representations.
